data.Title: 4318 - Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus Filling Station Maintenance Services
data.Description:
The purpose of this RFP is to obtain maintenance services for existing SCBA filling stations at various fire stations located within City of Nanaimo limits by a qualified Contractor. 

This Request for Proposal is subject to the New West Partnership Trade Agreement, the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Chapter 5), and the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (Chapter 19).

data.Title: 4364 - Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment Sales and Services
data.Description:
The City is seeking a Distributer of ChargePoint-brand Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE).  The existing EVSE network consists of 18 units supporting either fleet or public use, with public-facing EVSE subject to Electric Vehicle Recharging Bylaw 2024 No. 7365. 

The Agreement resulting from this RFP will be used to replace EVSE, expand the EVSE network, acquire accessories, and maintain warranty and networking services – on an ‘as-and-when-required’ basis.  Installation services may be requested through the duration of this Agreement however is not guaranteed.  This Agreement is primarily for the supply of goods.

The City does not guarantee any minimum purchase volume, quantity, or value under the Agreement.

Please refer to Section 5.0 for further details.

This Request for Proposal is subject to the New West Partnership Trade Agreement, the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Chapter 5), and the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (Chapter 19).

data.Title: 4207 - Unit4 Functional Consulting Services
data.Description:
The City of Nanaimo is asking for proposals from qualified and experienced Unit4 ERP Support Partners. The objective of this Request for Proposal (RFP) is to determine the Proponent that will provide best value in quality trusted consulting and advice to maintain and enhance the City’s Unit4 ERP assets that are further described in Section 5.0 Scope of Services and Specifications.

This Request for Proposal is subject to the New West Partnership Trade Agreement, the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Chapter 5), and the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (Chapter 19)

data.Title: 4389 - Supply and Deliver Mid-Size Electric Vehicles
data.Description:
The City invites Proposals from qualified suppliers for the supply and delivery of one (1) new mid-size battery electric-powered vehicle (EV) that can comfortably seat five (5) adults. The City may purchase additional units of the same vehicle from the Supplier at the same unit price and under the same terms and conditions of this RFP for a period of one (1) year from the date of the Agreement – further explained in Section 3.4.

The proposed vehicle must meet all mandatory requirements set out in Section 4.1 and the specifications detailed in the eight mandatory tables within the bid form in bids&tenders. Failure to meet any mandatory requirement will result in the Proposal being deemed non-compliant.

The scope is further described in Section 5.0 – Scope of Requirements.

As a high-level summary, Proponents should note that this RFP is for mid-size EVs only. For the purposes of this procurement, the proposed EVs must:

  1. Have a minimum driving range of 350 kms,
  2. Have an overall vehicle length between 4,572 mm and 4,978 mm, inclusive,
  3. Have a ground clearance of 127 mm or higher, and
  4. Have either a CCS or a NACS charging port and support DC Fast Charging.

The above four (4) requirements are mentioned here only to provide context regarding the type of EV sought under this RFP. However, the above represent only a small subset of the mandatory requirements. Proponents are responsible for ensuring that their proposed vehicle complies with all mandatory requirements set out in the bid form in bids&tenders.

The vehicle needs to be delivered in operating condition to the City of Nanaimo, Public Works Yard, Fleet Department – located at 2020 Labieux Road, Nanaimo, BC – V9T 6J9.

This Request for Proposal is subject to the New West Partnership Trade Agreement, the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Chapter 5), and the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (Chapter 19).

data.Title: 4409 - Consulting Services for Roofing Design
data.Description:
The purpose of this Request for Proposals is to secure Proposals from qualified Consultants to Provide roofing consulting services including design, technical procurement support, contract administration, and field review on an as-and-when-required basis. The first project awarded under this RFP is for the re-roofing of select roof areas at Beban Complex, located at 2300 Bowen Road, in Nanaimo.

The full scope of services is described in Section 5.

This Request for Proposal is subject to the New West Partnership Trade Agreement, the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Chapter 5), and the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (Chapter 19).

data.Title: 4354 - Market Sounding for Battery-Electric Refuse Collection Trucks and Operational Trials
data.Description:
The City of Nanaimo is seeking information from vendors of electric refuse collection vehicles who are prepared to provide vehicle information, deliver a vehicle to the City, provide operator orientation, and leave the vehicle with the City for a seven (7) day operational demonstration.

 

The City wishes to learn more about commercially available electric refuse collection vehicles and gain firsthand operating experience under typical municipal collection conditions. Further details regarding the information package and demonstration requirements are outlined in Section 4.0.

 

This RFI is intended to gather information that could assist the City in a potential future procurement process.

data.Title: 4393 - Water Meter Replacement Strategy
data.Description:
This RFSOQ is seeking professional consulting services to develop a long-term water meter replacement and modernization strategy. For more detailed information regarding the project scope, refer to Section 5 Terms of Reference.

This RFSOQ is the first stage of a two-stage process. The second stage includes negotiation starting with the highest ranked Respondent to select one Consultant.

This Request for Statement of Qualification is subject to the New West Partnership Trade Agreement, the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Chapter 5), and the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (Chapter 19).
